当您的应用需要实现虚拟商品购买功能（如游戏货币、道具、会员订阅等）时，可使用 IAP Kit 的购买接入能力
当您需要管理自动续期订阅商品的切换、续费逻辑时，可使用订阅相关能力
当您需要处理购买后的权益发放、退款处理、发票开具等售后流程，或需要查看收益分析报告时，也可以使用本 Kit 提供的完整支付生命周期管理能力
接入应用内购买收银台完成道具和会员购买 / Integrate the in-app purchase checkout for items and memberships
实现购买金币钻石等消耗型商品并发放库存 / Implement purchases of consumable goods like coins and gems and grant inventory
解锁去广告或高级功能等一次性买断内容 / Unlock one-time purchases such as ad removal or premium features
添加月度年度会员自动续费并管理订阅状态 / Add monthly or yearly auto-renewing memberships and manage subscription status
查询商品详情并在页面显示本地化价格 / Query product details and show localized prices in the UI
拉起华为支付流程并监听支付成功失败取消结果 / Launch the Huawei payment flow and handle success, failure, and cancel results
校验购买凭证并在服务端安全发放用户权益 / Verify purchase receipts and securely grant entitlements on the server
恢复用户已购的非消耗商品和有效订阅 / Restore previously purchased non-consumables and active subscriptions
处理续订升级降级补差价等订阅变更场景 / Handle subscription changes such as renewals, upgrades, downgrades, and proration
消费已购买但未核销的订单避免重复发货 / Consume completed but unconsumed orders to avoid duplicate delivery
同步订单记录并根据支付结果更新账号权益 / Sync order records and update account entitlements based on payment results
接入沙盒测试验证商品购买和订阅续期流程 / Integrate sandbox testing to verify purchases and subscription renewals
do_not_use_when: 需求是收集或管理用户账号、登录、身份认证，而非购买数字商品；应改用 account-kit / If the need is user account, sign-in, or identity management rather than buying digital goods, use account-kit instead
需求是读取、选择、搜索或管理通讯录联系人信息；应改用 contacts-kit / If the task is to read, pick, search, or manage contact information, use contacts-kit instead
需求是线下/线上实物商品、服务费用或通用交易支付，而不是应用内数字商品购买；应改用 payment-kit / If the task is paying for physical goods, services, or general transactions rather than in-app digital goods, use payment-kit instead
需求是管理卡券、票证、证件或钱包资产展示，不是发起应用内商品购买；应改用 wallet-kit / If the need is managing passes, tickets, credentials, or wallet assets rather than initiating in-app purchases, use wallet-kit instead
preconditions: 已在 AppGallery Connect 创建项目和应用，并开通/激活应用内购买服务 / The project and app have been created in AppGallery Connect, and the in-app purchase service has been enabled and activated
已在 AppGallery Connect 配置商品信息、应用身份信息及签名配置 / Product metadata, app identity information, and signing configuration have been set up in AppGallery Connect
设备已登录支持 IAP 的华为账号，且网络可访问华为 IAP 服务 / The device is signed in with a Huawei account that supports IAP, and network access to Huawei IAP services is available
如需 TV 嵌入式收银台，已申请对应开放能力权限 / If using the TV embedded checkout, the required open capability permission has been granted
inputs: 商品类型（消耗型、非消耗型、自动续期订阅、非续期订阅） / product type (consumable, non-consumable, auto-renewable subscription, non-renewing subscription)
开发者透传参数 developerPayload / developerPayload
购买令牌或订单号 / purchase token or order ID

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入 IAP 购买或订阅流程，并使用商品ID/商品类型发起购买请求 / The code integrates an IAP purchase or subscription flow and initiates a purchase request using product ID and product type
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify HarmonyOS code to invoke IAP purchase/subscription APIs with explicit product identifiers or product type information?

postconditions.statement: 已添加购买结果处理逻辑，能够根据成功、失败或取消结果更新应用流程 / Purchase result handling has been added so the app flow responds to success, failure, or cancellation outcomes
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there logic that handles multiple IAP outcomes such as success, failure, or user cancellation after the purchase call?

postconditions.statement: 已补充或说明权益发放与凭证校验相关处理，而非仅停留在拉起收银台 / Entitlement delivery and purchase proof verification are added or documented, rather than only launching the checkout
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include follow-up handling for entitlement delivery, token/order processing, or signature/JWT verification after a purchase completes?
